title: Amount of New Area Painted Each Day
summary: Given a 0-indexed 2D integer array paint of length n, where each element paint[i] is a start-end pair indicating the area to paint on the ith day, return an integer array worklog of length n.
statement: Given a 0-indexed 2D integer array paint of length n, where each element paint[i] is a start-end pair indicating the area to paint on the ith day, return an integer array worklog of length n. Each worklog[i] represents the amount of new area painted on the ith day, ensuring that no area is painted more than once.
constraints: Each [start,end] paints the half-open interval start <= x < end.
Previously painted positions do not count again, including overlap from nonadjacent earlier days.
Return the newly painted integer length for every day.
hints: After a position is painted, future scans should jump over it.
Store a successor link from each painted integer unit to the next candidate unit.
For each interval, find its first unpainted unit; paint it, link it forward, and repeat until end.
Successor links skip exactly the already painted unit cells, so each cell contributes once, on its first day.
editorial: Successor links skip exactly the already painted unit cells, so each cell contributes once, on its first day.

tests.explanation: The first two days add three units each; day three adds only [7,8), so return [3,3,1].
The second interval lies entirely inside prior paint and adds zero new area.
